objectTypes.description: A directed route between two selected places
The user decision to request a read-only ride estimate
One provider estimate for a route and vehicle category

estimatedAmount.description: Exact displayed estimate in CNY major units, otherwise null

feesComplete.description: Provider did not verify full fees

objectTypes.description: One provider read and its provenance

interfaceTypes.description: A source-resolved location with its address and provider coordinate reference system. DidiPlaces can return this Interface view through the receipt places Link. Its requestEstimate Action accepts origin and destination Location references and returns a RideRequest.
A route created by a Location requestEstimate Action. Its origin/destination Links expose the source endpoints for price calculation.
A current provider price observation, linked to its inquiry request and source receipt. Amount may be null for price ranges.

amount.description: Exact displayed estimate in CNY major units, otherwise null

functionTypes.description: Read current place candidates for city and keywords from DiDi. DidiPlaces is the data source that maps this result into Location objects and SourceReceipt links.

Read real prices for an existing RideRequest. Navigates its route Link and the RideEstimatable origin/destination Links. DidiEstimates maps this response to PriceEstimate objects linked to that request. Inquiry only, no order.

Final read and acceptance of one RideRequest: query linked PriceEstimate objects, verify source Links and freshness, return prices, route and accepted. Use after its DidiEstimates source refresh. Optional serviceClass selects a provider product name.
Whether both selected source locations have current coordinates and provenance. Used by route Action submission criteria.

actionTypes.description: Request prices between two source Place objects implementing Location, chosen to match the user intent. Creates the route, its origin/destination Links, and the RideRequest with its route Link atomically. Both endpoints require fresh source provenance. If source locations are ambiguous, ask the user before applying. Returns the request used by DidiEstimates. No car is ordered and no payment is made.
